name: Intentional Homicide Rate
description: Intentional homicides per 100,000 people (UNODC International Homicide Statistics). The most comparable cross-country measure of lethal violence.

name: Road Traffic Death Rate
description: WHO-modelled road traffic deaths per 100,000 people (Global Status Report on Road Safety).

name: Global Peace Index 2026
description: 23 indicators of societal safety, ongoing domestic and international conflict, and militarisation. Includes terrorism impact.

name: Organised Crime: Criminality Score
source: Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime
description: Expert-assessed scale and influence of 15 criminal markets and 5 types of criminal actor (Global Organized Crime Index 2025).

name: WorldRiskIndex 2026 (Disaster Risk)
source: Bündnis Entwicklung Hilft & IFHV Ruhr University Bochum
description: Exposure to earthquakes, tsunamis, floods, cyclones, drought and sea-level rise, combined with societal vulnerability.

name: Corruption Perceptions Index 2025
description: Perceived public-sector corruption, aggregated from 13 expert and business surveys.

name: Rule of Law (WGI)
description: Confidence in and abidance by the rules of society: contract enforcement, property rights, police, courts and crime.

name: Government Effectiveness (WGI)
description: Quality of public services and the civil service, and the credibility of policy formulation and implementation.

name: Regulatory Quality (WGI)
description: Ability of government to formulate and implement sound policies and regulations that permit and promote private-sector development.

name: GDP per Capita (PPP)
description: Gross domestic product per person at purchasing-power parity, i.e. adjusted for local price levels.

name: Income Inequality (Gini)
description: Gini index of household income or consumption from national surveys. Latest available survey year varies by country.

name: Unemployment Rate
source: ILO modelled estimates via World Bank WDI
description: Share of the labour force without work but available for and seeking employment (ILO harmonised definition).

name: Average Weekly Working Hours
description: Mean weekly hours actually worked per employed person. Scored 100 at 35 hours or fewer, falling to 0 at 50 hours.

name: Economic Complexity Index
source: Harvard Growth Lab (Atlas of Economic Complexity)
description: Diversity and sophistication of the goods a country exports — a proxy for productive know-how and future growth.

name: Healthy Life Expectancy (HALE)
description: Average number of years a newborn can expect to live in full health.

name: Universal Health Coverage Index
description: Coverage of essential health services: reproductive and child health, infectious and non-communicable disease, service capacity.

name: Under-5 Mortality Rate
source: UN IGME via World Bank WDI
description: Probability of a child dying before age five (UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation).

name: Education Index (HDI)
description: UNDP education index: average of mean years of schooling (adults) and expected years of schooling (children).

name: World Press Freedom Index 2026
description: Political, economic, legal, social and safety conditions for journalists, from expert questionnaires and abuse counts.

name: Liberal Democracy Index
description: Electoral democracy plus constraints on the executive, judicial independence and protection of individual liberties.

name: Academic Freedom Index
description: Freedom to research and teach, academic exchange, institutional autonomy, campus integrity and freedom of academic expression.

name: Freedom of Religion
description: Expert-coded freedom to choose, practise and change religion, including freedom from state religious repression.

name: Women, Peace and Security Index 2025
source: Georgetown Institute for Women, Peace and Security & PRIO
description: Women's inclusion (education, jobs, finance, politics), justice (legal discrimination, son bias) and security (intimate partner violence, community safety).

name: LGBTQ+ Legal Equality Index
source: Equaldex Equality Index via Our World in Data
description: Legal status of same-sex relationships, marriage, adoption, discrimination protection, gender-marker changes and conversion therapy.

name: Fixed Broadband Download Speed
description: Test-weighted mean fixed-broadband download speed across all Speedtest map tiles in the country, July–September 2026.

name: Internet Users
description: Share of the population that used the internet in the last three months.

name: Access to Electricity
description: Share of the population with access to electricity.

name: Logistics Performance Index
description: Efficiency of customs, quality of trade and transport infrastructure, shipment timeliness and tracking, from a survey of logistics professionals.

name: Climate Comfort (where people live)
source: Derived from WorldClim 2.1 normals + GeoNames city populations
description: Population-weighted climate of every city over 15,000 people. Each month scores 100 minus penalties for daytime highs below 20°C (4/°C) or above 28°C (6/°C), nights below 5°C (2/°C), dew point above 16°C (5/°C) and rain above 100 mm (0.15/mm, max 30); the 12-month average makes up 80%, and sunshine (solar radiation 2.5–6 kWh/m²/day) the other 20%.

name: Air Pollution (PM2.5)
description: Population-weighted annual mean concentration of fine particulate matter. WHO guideline: 5 μg/m³.

name: Safely Managed Drinking Water
source: WHO/UNICEF JMP via World Bank WDI
description: Share of people using an improved water source on premises, available when needed and free from contamination.

name: Environmental Performance Index 2026
description: 58 indicators of environmental health, ecosystem vitality and climate-change mitigation.

name: ND-GAIN Climate Adaptation Index
description: Vulnerability to climate change combined with readiness (economic, governance, social) to adapt.
